title.title: Honour
title.overview: There's no statute of limitations on revenge. A mystery thriller about three female lawyers who confront the past head-on, as it returns as a massive scandal.

episodes.name: The Confession
episodes.overview: As the nation is rocked by a scandal involving 'national actor' Kang Eun-seok, who is accused of having an inappropriate sexual relationship with a high school girl, Yoo-jeong, Hyun-jin, a lawyer at L&J, struggles to prove Eun-seok’s guilt. By chance, Hyun-jin overhears a conversation about the Eun-seok – Yoo-jeong case at the home of her former lover, Jun-hyeok, and is taken aback to realize that the case is far bigger than she had imagined.

episodes.name: The Unveiled Truths
episodes.overview: Jun-hyeok is found dead, and Yoo-jeong claims that she killed him. Hyun-jin finds it hard to believe, so she tries to find out the truth behind Ra-young and Shin-jae. Hyun-jin meets Seon-hwa, hoping she’d share some information about Jun-hyeok. Meanwhile, Ra-young comes home, only to be attacked by a mysterious man.

episodes.name: The Consequences of the Statement Recanting
episodes.overview: Seon-gyu takes DNA samples from Ra-young and Hyun-jin to compare them with the DNA found on an earring discovered at Jun-hyeok’s house. Ra-young pulls some strings so that the police don’t get their hands on Hyun-jin’s DNA. On the day of the crime scene reenactment, Yoo-jeong recants her statement.

episodes.name: The Man Hidden Behind
episodes.overview: Ra-young goes to see Min-seo at the restaurant she works at to convince her to get their help. Seon-gyu accuses Hyun-jin of visiting Jun-hyeok’s place on the day of his death. Min-seo decides to get help from L&J under one condition: To live with one of them. Min-seo starts working for L&J, and meets one of the clients from Connect.

episodes.name: An Old Friend
episodes.overview: Park Ju Hwan visits Ra Young at her office, leaving her shaken. He tells her that he’s going to reinvestigate his case from 20 years ago. Shin Jae finds out that Ju Hwan is part of the Connect scheme. Meanwhile, Attorney Kwon Jung Hyeon takes over LnJ as the new head in order to send Shin Jae to Haeil.

episodes.name: The Inside Men
episodes.overview: Hyun Jin shares the news with Seon Kyu that she’s pregnant. However, at the doctor’s appointment, Seon Kyu realizes that the baby might not be his. Jun Hyeok’s laptop gets recovered, and the voice recording of an interview with Yoo Jeong is revealed. Meanwhile, Lee Seon Hwa steals Jun Hyeok’s laptop for the corrupt cop.

episodes.name: Another Victim
episodes.overview: Seon-hwa is found dead in an abandoned building, but Jun-hyeok’s laptop is nowhere to be found. Shin-jae decides to marry Tae-joo, announcing to her mother that L&J will go independent. Meanwhile, another victim of Connect is found at Magan Hotel, and Shin-jae asks Tae-joo's help to rescue her.

episodes.name: The Long Awaited Disclosure
episodes.overview: Ra Young manages to save Yeon Hee from Je Yeol. Hyeon Jin saves Da Eun, the victim of Connect, from the hotel room and transfers her to the hospital. Ra Young exposes Connect In live on a news show. After the show airs, the victims of Connect visit the LnJ office to reveal the truth.

episodes.name: All-Out Attack On LnJ
episodes.overview: With enough statements gathered from the victims, LnJ decides to go public with the list of Connect In’s clients. As a result of this exposure, a significant social uproar rises, and Joint Investigation Headquarters is formed. However, the lead prosecutors at the Joint Investigation HQ turn out to be Haeil’s clients, and Shin Jae immediately realises her mom is behind it.

episodes.name: The Mastermind
episodes.overview: Ra Young gets imprisoned for murdering Je Yeol. While looking for ways to get Ra Young out, Shin Jae and Hyun Jin find out who Han Min Seo really is. Shin Jae confronts Baek Tae Joo after finding out that he was the mastermind behind Connect In. Ra Young’s trial is held under unfavourable circumstances, with no additional witnesses coming.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Resolution
episodes.overview: Ra-young goes to see Min-seo at the restaurant she works at to convince her to get their help. Seon-gyu accuses Hyun-jin of visiting Jun-hyeok’s place on the day of his death. Min-seo decides to get help from L&J under one condition: To live with one of them. Min-seo starts working for L&J, and meets one of the clients from Connect.

episodes.name: The Final Verdict
episodes.overview: Ra-young reveals that Baek Tae-ju is the man behind Connect In during The Prime’s Technical Demonstration. Ra-young and Hyun-jin suggest Shin-jae return to L&J, but she refuses. Shin-Jae tries her best to clean up the damage caused by Haeil, but she faces difficulties due to one man who remains an obstacle until the very end.
